pair.title: Pair HD Blind
pair.description: Hold the blind's physical pairing button for 3 seconds, then select Submit within 90 seconds.

error.cannot_pair: Could not enroll. Reopen pairing mode and keep the blind near an active Bluetooth proxy.

abort.no_devices_found: No blinds running HD custom firmware were found.

init.title: Calibrate blind travel
init.description:
Start with the upper limit, then set the lower limit. Starting clears the previous calibration. Only short, locally timed pulses move the motor. Stay with the blind while calibrating.

{error}

upper.title: 1. Set upper limit

lower.title: 2. Set lower limit

error.command_failed: The blind rejected the command. Stop any motion and check connectivity.

abort.calibration_cancelled: Calibration cancelled. Start again to set both endpoints.
abort.cancel_failed: Could not contact the blind. Jogs stop automatically. Reconnect and cancel or restart calibration.
